intro: Experienced full-stack developer with over 10 years of experience in IT and database architecture design, including more than 5.5 years focused on commercial development of distributed cloud applications, microservices, and web interfaces with Node.js (TypeScript) and React.

expertise.title: Backend expertise
expertise.description: Deep knowledge of Node.js (NestJS, Express.js), asynchronous Python (FastAPI), enterprise development with SAP CAP (with Node.js), microservice architecture, and BFF and API Gateway patterns.

expertise.title: Frontend expertise
expertise.description: Design of complex SPAs, interactive dashboards, and real-time interfaces with React (TypeScript, Redux Toolkit) following the FSD methodology. SAPUI5 development using vendor best practices.

expertise.title: Data and high load
expertise.description: Strong experience with very large databases (180+ GB, 20+ million records), complex SQL query optimization, NoSQL (MongoDB), caching (Redis), and message queues (RabbitMQ, Kafka).

expertise.title: AI/LLM engineering
expertise.description: Hands-on experience deploying local AI environments (Ollama, Gemma) and designing end-to-end RAG pipelines.
